# P23: Module 1 — 1337 Military Order Historical Overhaul & 4 Order Laws (TEU/LIV/KNI)
# Expected full pass at 1337: 1111
#   +1    TEU alive, owns malbork & konigsberg & torun as cores, tolerates pruthenian
#   +10   LIV alive, owns parnu & cesis as cores, tolerates latvian & estonian
#   +100  KNI alive + oe_teu_balleien_tier1_mod DB valid
#   +1000 oe_teu_law_transition_mod DB valid + TEU/LIV/KNI recognized by oe_teu_is_military_order
oe_probe4_run_p23 = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_probe4_p23 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = c:TEU
			location:malbork = { owner ?= c:TEU is_core_of = c:TEU }
			location:konigsberg = { owner ?= c:TEU is_core_of = c:TEU }
			location:torun = { owner ?= c:TEU is_core_of = c:TEU }
			c:TEU = { has_tolerated_culture = culture:pruthenian }
		}
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe4_p23 add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = c:LIV
			location:parnu = { owner ?= c:LIV is_core_of = c:LIV }
			location:cesis = { owner ?= c:LIV is_core_of = c:LIV }
			c:LIV = {
				has_tolerated_culture = culture:latvian
				has_tolerated_culture = culture:estonian
			}
		}
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe4_p23 add = 10 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:KNI }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_teu_balleien_tier1_mod }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe4_p23 add = 100 }
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_teu_balleien_tier1_mod days = 2 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_teu_balleien_tier1_mod }
			change_variable = { name = oe_probe4_p23 add = 100 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_teu_balleien_tier1_mod
		}
	}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			c:TEU ?= { oe_teu_is_military_order = yes }
			c:LIV ?= { oe_teu_is_military_order = yes }
			c:KNI ?= { oe_teu_is_military_order = yes }
		}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_teu_law_transition_mod }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe4_p23 add = 1000 }
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_teu_law_transition_mod days = 2 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_teu_law_transition_mod }
			change_variable = { name = oe_probe4_p23 add = 1000 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_teu_law_transition_mod
		}
	}
	}
}

# P24: Module 2 — 5 Building-Type HRE Bailiwicks (OTB1..OTB5), Statecraft & Subject Lock
# Expected full pass at 1337: 1111
#   +1    OTB1..OTB5 all exist with country_type = building and is_subject_type = oe_teu_ballei
#   +10   All 5 host cities remain owned by BOH/HAB/BRA/TEU/KOL (0 land detached!)
#   +100  OTB1 recognized as protected by oe_is_protected_special_subject (29-type lock!)
#   +1000 oe_thh_kernel_yearly runs (global_var:oe_thh_ran_y set) + oe_thh_ballei_compliant_mod DB valid
oe_probe4_run_p24 = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_probe4_p24 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = c:OTB1 c:OTB1 = { country_type = building is_subject_type = oe_teu_ballei }
			country_exists = c:OTB2 c:OTB2 = { country_type = building is_subject_type = oe_teu_ballei }
			country_exists = c:OTB3 c:OTB3 = { country_type = building is_subject_type = oe_teu_ballei }
			country_exists = c:OTB4 c:OTB4 = { country_type = building is_subject_type = oe_teu_ballei }
			country_exists = c:OTB5 c:OTB5 = { country_type = building is_subject_type = oe_teu_ballei }
		}
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe4_p24 add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			location:prague = { owner ?= c:BOH }
			location:vienna = { owner ?= c:HAB }
			location:berlin = { owner ?= c:BRA }
			location:mergentheim = { owner ?= c:TEU }
			location:cologne = { owner ?= c:KOL }
		}
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe4_p24 add = 10 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { c:OTB1 ?= { oe_is_protected_special_subject = yes } }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe4_p24 add = 100 }
	}
	oe_thh_kernel_yearly = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_thh_ran_y }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_thh_ballei_compliant_mod }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe4_p24 add = 1000 }
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_thh_ballei_compliant_mod days = 2 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_thh_ballei_compliant_mod }
			change_variable = { name = oe_probe4_p24 add = 1000 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_thh_ballei_compliant_mod
		}
	}
	}
}

# P25: Modules 3-4 — 7-Tier Eastern Enfeoffment, Situation, Missions & Hospitaller North-South Pact
# Expected full pass at 1337: 1111
#   +1    oe_tom_kernel_yearly runs (global_var:oe_tom_ran_y set) + TEU is valid host
#   +10   oe_kni_kernel_yearly runs (global_var:oe_kni_ran_y set) + KNI valid host
#   +100  oe_tom_mod_march_charter DB valid (Module 3 Ordensmark / Northern Crusade)
#   +1000 oe_kni_mod_dec_rhodes_fortress DB valid (Module 4 Hospitaller & Black x White Cross Pact)
oe_probe4_run_p25 = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_probe4_p25 value = 0 }
	oe_tom_kernel_yearly = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = oe_tom_ran_y
			c:TEU ?= { oe_tom_is_overlord_host = yes }
		}
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe4_p25 add = 1 }
	}
	oe_kni_kernel_yearly = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = oe_kni_ran_y
			country_exists = c:KNI
		}
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe4_p25 add = 10 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_tom_mod_march_charter }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe4_p25 add = 100 }
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_tom_mod_march_charter days = 2 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_tom_mod_march_charter }
			change_variable = { name = oe_probe4_p25 add = 100 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_tom_mod_march_charter
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_kni_mod_dec_rhodes_fortress }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe4_p25 add = 1000 }
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_kni_mod_dec_rhodes_fortress days = 2 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_kni_mod_dec_rhodes_fortress }
			change_variable = { name = oe_probe4_p25 add = 1000 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_kni_mod_dec_rhodes_fortress
		}
	}
}
